## Manual release approval required

This automated release PR intentionally keeps GitHub's native Actions approval gate. Review its exact head SHA and, when GitHub marks the **CI** run as `action_required`, approve that exact run. Then wait for the independently dispatched `zuno/pr-gate` candidate to succeed, revalidate the same head, and merge manually. Do not bypass approval with CI skip markers or `pull_request_target`.
